Name: Truffle Collector
Author: mdurham6890
Description: I thought this would be a fair way to allow for auto collection of truffles towards end game. That way there is less worry about missing out on money and coming back to the farm every night. I wanted this item to feel like it could have been a natural part of the game. Please let me know if you think the requirements are too steep or not steep enough. It should feel earned like when you get the auto grabber.

Downloads.Description: Update that allows the collector to work on Ginger Island for those who are using the Buildable Ginger Island Farm mod.

Manifest.Name: Truffle Collector
Manifest.Description: Adds a craftable Truffle Collector that automatically gathers truffles left by pigs, just like the Auto-Grabber collects milk and eggs.
